rows.en: Focuses on the status of individuals as employed, unemployed, or inactive.

rows.en: Focuses on the proportion of the working-age population that is either employed or actively seeking work.

clarification.en: Unemployment refers to those without work, while underemployment refers to those working below their skill level or for fewer hours than desired.
clarification.hi: Unemployment refers to those without work, while underemployment refers to those working below their skill level or for fewer hours than desired.

relationship.en: The unemployment rate is calculated as the percentage of the labour force that is unemployed.
